duration.text: The Textile engineering at Shanghai University Of Engineering Science is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: High school diploma or equivalent certificate, all high school courses and their transcripts or equivalent transcripts Certificate of English proficiencyCopy of passport If passport has been extended, passport extension page should be provided. If you are not in your country of origin at the time of registration, a valid visa from your current country of residence is required. Electronic passport size photographs Study plan The applicant undertaking Proof of financial guarantee or financial guarantee undertakingProof of no criminal record or undertaking of no criminal record Other application materials required by the school. Awards, certificates of honor, or other materials that students find helpful in their application. Those who have experience in China are required to provide all visa, residence permit, certificate of study or completion, transcript, temporary accommodation registration form and other documents

requirements.text: Over 18 years old, under 25 years old (over 16 years old, under 18 years old, need to submit a guardian guarantee)Physical and mental health High school graduate or above Non-chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport5Good English proficiency (need to submit English proficiency certificate or pass our school English proficiency test)
